text:
elin: heads up — encountered AttributeError in python sdk: no admin.rate_limits.list binding while testing onboarding sample app. docs only show curl.
owen: which path did you try?
elin: client.admin.rate_limits.list(org_id='org_abc') -> AttributeError. but REST works: GET /v1/admin/rate-limits?org_id=org_abc returns payload.
kai: also saw retry behavior mismatch: server replies 429 with Retry-After header but sdk retries immediately because RetryError doesn't keep header info. we need the header surfaced so backoff obeys server.
elin: repro: from redwood import RedwoodClient; c=RedwoodClient(KEY); c.admin.rate_limits.list(org_id='org_abc')
logs: RetryError: backoff exhausted (cause: 429) -- headers: {"retry-after":"10"} but SDK error has no retry_after field.
owen: sounds like two issues: missing generated binding + retry policy not parsing Retry-After. I'll regen client and patch RetryPolicy to attach retry_after to the exception.
bot-ci: issue DEVEX-3890 created and assigned to owen.
kai: also noticed model field drift: REST returns "window_seconds" but our python model maps it to "window". sample-app expected window_seconds and displayed wrong values.
elin: that caused onboarding demo flake.
owen: will update generator to preserve server keys (or add alias) and add a compatibility shim + unit tests. also run typescript SDK gen to check parity.
kai: i'll update the sample-app and add integration test asserting SDK exposes retry_after and correct field names.
elin: thanks, ping us when PR merges so we can update onboarding env.
owen: will include release notes and ping #release-war-room for dedicated customers who pin SDKs.
